name: ピクセル反復解析
description: Analyzes ピクセル pattern repetition in frame
algorithm: Pixel Repetition — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method detects pixel-level repetition patterns in video for deepfake detection:

1. **空間的Repetition検出**: The method searches for exact or near-exact pixel pattern repetitions within each frame. Copy-paste manipulation and some AI generators produce repeated pixel patterns (tiled textures from the generator's feature map).

2. **GeneratorArchitectureアーティファクト検出**: GAN generators using transposed convolution upsampling can produce characteristic periodic pixel patterns ("checkerboard artifacts") at the generator's stride frequency. The method detects these periodic spatial repetitions in the frequency domain using spectral analysis.

3. **時間的ピクセルRepetition**: The method checks for repeated pixel patterns across frames — exact pixel-level repetition between non-adjacent frames indicates artificial frame generation or copying. Natural video never produces exact pixel-level repetition between distinct frames.

4. **PatchSimilarity分析**: Local patches are compared using normalized cross-correlation. Unusually high similarity between distant patches (beyond what natural texture would produce) indicates AI generation where the generator's limited diversity manifests as repeated micro-patterns.

5. **Repetition-Scale分析**: Repetition is analyzed at multiple spatial scales. Natural textures can show repetition at macro scales (wallpaper, fabric patterns) but not at micro scales. AI-generated content may show micro-scale repetition invisible to human inspection but detectable statistically.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through ピクセル repetition analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
